# Select

One choice from a list too long to lay out. Fewer than five choices belong in `Segmented` or a `RadioGroup`.

## Anatomy

A trigger showing the current choice and a chevron, and a listbox that opens beneath it.

| `label` | `string` | — | Only when the select stands outside a `FormField`. |
| `id` | `string` | ``sanctum-select-${crypto.randomUUID()}`` | — |
| `describedby` | `string` | — | — |

## Variants

None.

## States

Closed, open, disabled, invalid, placeholder.

## Keyboard

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter`, `Space`, `↓`, `↑` | Open the list from the trigger. |
| `↓`, `↑` | Move the active option. |
| `Home`, `End` | Jump to the first and last option. |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Commit the active option and return focus to the trigger. |
| `Escape` | Dismiss without committing, returning focus to the trigger. |
| `Tab` | Dismiss without committing and move on. |

## ARIA

The trigger carries `aria-haspopup="listbox"` and `aria-expanded`. The list is `role="listbox"` with `aria-activedescendant` pointing at the active option, following the WAI-ARIA listbox pattern.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.

## Reference correspondence

None. The reference has no counterpart; this component is designed in its idiom — hairline rules, square corners, mono micro-labels, the display face reserved for display type — and reviewed against its neighbours.

## Recorded deviations

| What | Why |
| --- | --- |
| It became a real listbox. | The reference's select is a button and a div with no roles, no keyboard handling and no focus return — it can only be operated with a pointer. |
